name: napalm-budgeted-command-batch-execution
instr:
Give NAPALM callers one deterministic time allowance for an ordered command batch, with portable partial results when execution cannot finish. Enforce that allowance at each native transport boundary so timed-out work has stopped when the call returns, while preserving the existing unbudgeted CLI contract.

A positive finite `CommandBudget` from `napalm.base.command_budget` governs one monotonic allowance across the entire batch; invalid totals raise `InvalidCommandBudget` from `napalm.base.exceptions` before any device activity. `InvalidCommandBudget` and `CommandBatchError` from `napalm.base.exceptions` are `ValueError` subclasses. Every input position, including duplicates, has an ordered `CommandOutcome` from `napalm.base.command_result`, retaining its encoding and native value or safe error detail under the appropriate `CommandOutcomeStatus`. Exhaustion, native timeout, and terminal command or transport failure stop further submission, preserve earlier outcomes, preserve command-specific native value shapes and error distinctions in portable outcomes, classify the terminal command distinctly, and mark later commands `NOT_STARTED`, with consistent nonnegative accounting in `CommandBatchResult`. EOS, IOS, IOS-XR, IOS-XR NETCONF, Junos, NXOS, NXOS SSH, and MockDriver expose this contract without fabricating unsupported execution, and supported transports receive no timeout greater than the remaining allowance.
